Name: BONFIRE_WARP_PARAM_ST
Description: The Sites of Grace: each row is one grace asset's world-map pin and fast-travel (warp list) entry. In the warp list a grace is grouped under its subcategory (BonfireWarpSubCategoryParam), and each subcategory belongs to a tab (BonfireWarpTabParam). A grace is shown only while it's unlocked, enabled for the current map, and at least one of its texts is visible.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build. Appears unused by the game (retail sets it on most rows, which work normally).
Padding.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Unlock Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: The grace's discovered flag. While it's on, the grace is lit, its pin shows on the world map and it's listed for warping; the grace asset's lit state is kept in step with this flag. 0: always unlocked. Retail: 71000 onward, one per grace.

Fields.Name: Grace Entity ID
Fields.Description: Entity ID of the grace asset this row describes. The game finds a grace's row by this ID (resting at it, its unlit SFX, its lit state, script warps), and the map pin keeps it as the warp destination. Opening the warp list at a grace selects that grace's tab.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Sort Order in Subcategory
Fields.Description: Position of this grace within its subcategory in the warp list, ascending.

Fields.Name: Warp Prohibition Icon ID
Fields.Description: Map icon meant to replace Icon ID when warping to this grace isn't allowed. The pin is always created in the normal state and no switch to this icon was found, so it may never show. Retail: 2.

Fields.Name: Display Min Zoom Step
Fields.Description: The pin is drawn only when the map zoom step is at least this (0 is fully zoomed out, +1 per zoom level). 0: always drawn. Retail: 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Selection Min Zoom Step
Fields.Description: The pin can be selected (and the cursor snaps to it) only when the map zoom step is at least this (0 is fully zoomed out, +1 per zoom level). 0: always. Retail: 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Subcategory ID
Fields.Description: The BonfireWarpSubCategoryParam row this grace is listed under; that subcategory's Tab ID gives the warp list tab. A grace whose subcategory row doesn't exist, or whose tab's Text ID is below 0, is left out of the warp list.

Fields.Name: Cleared Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: While this event flag is on, the pin shows its "cleared" mark. 0: never shows it. Unused in retail.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Map icon of the grace pin. Replaced by NPC Icon ID while a visible text is an NPC name. Retail: 1 (Table of Lost Grace: 48).

Fields.Name: Show on Lands Between Map (M00)
Fields.Description: The grace appears on the surface world map (M00): its pin, and its warp list entry while that map is shown.

Fields.Name: Show on Underground Map (M01)
Fields.Description: The grace appears on the underground map (M01): its pin, and its warp list entry while that map is shown.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Show on Land of Shadow Map
Fields.Description: The grace appears on the Land of Shadow map: its pin, and its warp list entry while that map is shown.
Padding.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Map Area
Fields.Description: AA part of the mAA_BB_CC_00 map the position is relative to (60 for the Lands Between overworld, 61 for the Land of Shadow).

Fields.Name: Map Block X
Fields.Description: BB part of the mAA_BB_CC_00 map the position is relative to.

Fields.Name: Map Block Z
Fields.Description: CC part of the mAA_BB_CC_00 map the position is relative to.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Coordinate: X
Fields.Description: X coordinate of the grace, relative to the map set by Map Area / Block X / Block Z. Places the pin on the world map.

Fields.Name: Coordinate: Y
Fields.Description: Y (height) coordinate of the grace, relative to its map. Read with X and Z when the position is converted; the world map itself is top-down.

Fields.Name: Coordinate: Z
Fields.Description: Z coordinate of the grace, relative to the map set by Map Area / Block X / Block Z. Places the pin on the world map.

Fields.Name: Text ID [1]
Fields.Description: Text shown for the grace on the map and in the warp list: a Place Name or NPC Name entry, picked by Text Type [1]. -1: none. The text is visible while all its set Enable flags are on and not all of its set Disable flags are on. A grace without any visible text is hidden from the map and the warp list.

Fields.Name: Text Enable Flag ID [1]
Fields.Description: Text 1 is shown only while this event flag is on. Combined with Text Enable Flag ID 2 [1]: every set flag must be on. 0: no condition.

Fields.Name: Text Disable Flag ID [1]
Fields.Description: Text 1 is hidden while this event flag is on, overriding the Enable flags. Combined with Text Disable Flag ID 2 [1]: the text is hidden only when every set Disable flag is on. 0: no condition.
